# tests/fixtures/gh-shim-census.txt — every `gh pr|issue|run|repo` form the
# harness really writes, one argv per line (after the word `gh`).
#
# WHAT READS IT: tests/gh-passthrough-budget.bh-791-test.sh drives every line
# through the real bin/gh-rest-shim and asserts the pass-through log stays
# empty, and it scans bin/**/*.sh, catalog/ and skills/ for `gh <group> <verb>`
# at command position and asserts that verb set is a SUBSET of this file. A new
# subcommand in the harness is red until it is added here, where the shim must
# then prove it translates it.
#
# `#` and blank lines are ignored. A line starting with `!` is a verb the
# harness calls that the shim deliberately does NOT translate; the suite asserts
# those DO log a pass-through, at depth=1.
#
# Two placeholders the suite substitutes at run time:
#   @BODYFILE@  a temp file holding a PR body
#   @DIR@       a scratch clone target
#
# reads — pr
pr view 1 -R o/r --json state,number,url,headRefName,baseRefName,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,labels,title,body,isDraft,mergedAt,statusCheckRollup
pr view 1 -R o/r --json state,mergeCommit,mergedAt
pr view https://github.com/o/r/pull/1 --json state,number,url
pr view 1 -R o/r --json comments
pr view 1 -R o/r --json files
pr view 1 -R o/r --json reviews
pr view 1 -R o/r --json commits
pr view 1 -R o/r --json author,labels -q .author.login
pr list -R o/r --state all --search "BH-1"
pr list -R o/r --state open --limit 100 --json number,headRefName,title
pr list -R o/r --state merged --limit 30 --json number,mergedAt
pr list -R o/r --head feature --json number,url
pr list -R o/r --base main --state open --json number
pr list -R o/r --label ai-build --json number,labels
pr list -R o/r --author app/example-org-bot --state open --json number,author
# reads — issue
issue view 1 -R o/r --json title,body,comments,labels,state
issue view 1 -R o/r --json number,state,labels
issue list -R o/r --label ai-build --state open --limit 100 --json number,title,labels,updatedAt,comments
issue list -R o/r --state all --limit 1000 --json title
issue list -R o/r --label ai-build --state open --search "up10: o/r" --json number,title
# reads — repo
repo view o/r --json name,defaultBranchRef,isArchived
repo view -R o/r --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name
repo clone o/r @DIR@
# reads — actions
run view 42 -R o/r --json status,conclusion
run view 42 -R o/r --json databaseId,headSha,conclusion -q .conclusion
run view 42 -R o/r --log-failed
run list -R o/r --workflow harness-ci.yml --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,headSha
run rerun 42 -R o/r --failed
# writes — pr
pr create -R o/r --title "t" --body "b" --base main --head feature
pr create -R o/r --title "t" --body-file @BODYFILE@ --base main --head feature --label ai-build --draft
pr edit 1 -R o/r --add-label ready
pr edit 1 -R o/r --base main
pr close 1 -R o/r --comment "c"
pr reopen 1 -R o/r
pr comment 1 -R o/r --body "hi"
pr review 1 -R o/r --approve --body "ok"
pr diff 1 -R o/r --name-only
pr diff 1 -R o/r
pr merge 1 -R o/r --squash --delete-branch
# writes — issue
issue create -R o/r --title "t" --body "b" --label ai-build
issue edit 1 -R o/r --add-label ai-build
issue comment 1 -R o/r --body "hi"
issue close 1 -R o/r --comment "done"
# NEVER TRANSLATED — a long-poll watch is not one REST call. These two must
# still be listed, because the subset ratchet reads this file as the whole set
# of verbs the harness is allowed to call.
!pr checks https://github.com/o/r/pull/1 --required --watch --fail-fast
!run watch 42 -R o/r --exit-status
# `gh pr ready` (bin/lib/data-lane-pending.sh, BH-6467) has no REST form: it is the
# GraphQL markPullRequestReadyForReview mutation, so it passes through by design.
!pr ready https://github.com/o/r/pull/1
